description.zh: 专业短剧剧本创作：从选题策划、故事方案、角色设计，到 20-100 集分集目录、单集剧本、爽点钩子自检与导出，覆盖都市情感、霸总、甜宠、重生、悬疑等中文短剧全类型。
description.en: Professional short-drama scriptwriting: topic selection, story treatment, character design, 20-100 episode outlines, single-episode scripts, hook/paywall self-checks and export — covering romance, CEO, sweet-pet, rebirth and suspense genres.

welcome_message.zh: 从选题到分集剧本的短剧创作全流程
welcome_message.en: Full short-drama writing flow from topic to episode scripts

description.zh: 一句话概念、卖点、主线冲突

prompt.zh: 我想写一部短剧，题材方向：（例如：都市甜宠/重生复仇/悬疑反转），目标受众和集数：（例如：女性向，60集）。请给出故事方案：一句话概念、核心卖点、世界观、主线冲突和人物弧光。
prompt.en: I want to write a short drama. Genre: (e.g. urban romance / rebirth revenge / suspense twist), audience and episode count: (e.g. female-skewing, 60 episodes). Give me a story treatment: logline, selling points, world, main conflict, character arcs.

description.zh: 身份、动机、秘密与反差感

prompt.zh: 基于以下故事背景，设计主要角色：身份、动机、秘密、人物关系网和反差萌点，并说明每个角色承担的爽点功能。（贴上你的故事方案或一句话背景）
prompt.en: Based on this story background, design the main cast: identity, motives, secrets, relationship web and contrast points, noting which payoff each character delivers. (Paste your treatment or premise)

prompt.zh: 用以下方案生成分集目录（每集一句话主事件，标出关键反转和付费卡点）：（贴上故事方案与角色设定）
prompt.en: Turn this treatment into an episode outline (one main event per episode, marking key reversals and paywall hooks): (paste treatment & characters)

description.zh: 场景头+动作+对白+情绪提示

prompt.zh: 根据分集目录写第（N）集完整剧本：场景头、动作描写、对白、情绪提示，对白短狠准，结尾留钩子。写完后按抓人度、冲突密度、爽点频率自检一遍并修正。
prompt.en: Write the full script for episode (N) from the outline: scene heads, action, dialogue, emotion cues — punchy lines, ending on a hook. Then self-check for opening grip, conflict density and payoff frequency, and fix issues.

zh: 给我出 5 个「重生+豪门」题材的短剧概念，各配一句话卖点
这是我的故事方案，设计男女主和反派的角色卡，要求动机不脸谱化
把这份方案展开成 80 集分集目录，每 10 集一个大反转
写第 1 集剧本，前 3 秒必须有冲突或悬念，结尾卡付费点
这集剧本帮我自检：爽点密度够不够，钩子在哪，哪里注水了
把选定方案导出成可拍摄格式：分场剧本 + 角色小传 + 分集梗概三份文件
en: Pitch 5 'rebirth + wealthy family' drama concepts, each with a one-line hook
Design protagonist and antagonist character cards from my treatment — no cartoon villains
Expand this treatment into an 80-episode outline with a major reversal every 10 episodes
Write episode 1: conflict within the first 3 seconds, ending on a paywall cliffhanger
Self-check this script: payoff density, hook placement, where it drags
Export the chosen package as shootable files: scene script + character bios + episode synopsis
